analysis_set.span: Analyses will be conducted on an intention-to-treat basis.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death from any cause within 90 days after randomization.

notes: The held full text is the PLUS statistical analysis plan, not the results report. It establishes planned ITT analyses generally, but does not independently confirm the analysis set actually used for the served mortality counts. The plan excludes data without consent or with withdrawn consent and specifies primary analysis without imputation of missing data. Entry criteria describe critically ill adults requiring fluid resuscitation; no criterion places participants outside the question's population.
